raw_graphql_pull_request.body:
## Purpose

Adds TP4 and lowest-latency (specialized decode) presets to the Mistral Large 4 recipe, so MI350X and MI355X both offer them for the FP8 and Quark MXFP4 checkpoints. Also fixes the AMD `docker run` command.

New presets:
- MI350X, MXFP4 (Quark): `mi350x_mxfp4_tp4`, `mi350x_mxfp4_tp4_specialized`
- MI355X, FP8: `mi355x_tp4`, `mi355x_tp4_specialized`
- MI355X, MXFP4 (Quark): `mi355x_mxfp4_tp4`, `mi355x_mxfp4_tp4_specialized`

TP4 is the baseline at `--tensor-parallel-size 4` with DSpark. Lowest latency adds `--additional-config '{"decode_backend":"latency_specialized"}'`. FP8 also sets `VLLM_FP8_MOE_REQUANT_ACT=a4w4`. Quark sets no requant variables, because its routed experts are already MXFP4 a4w4. The MI355X specialized presets keep the baseline's `--max-num-seqs 128`. The MI350X Quark one sets `--max-num-seqs 64` to match the existing MI350X FP8 preset.

**AMD `docker run` fix.** `vllm/vllm-openai-rocm:mistral-large-4` has no entrypoint. Setting `docker_serve_command: "vllm serve"` for mi350x and mi355x renders `<image> vllm serve <model> …`.

## Test Result

All checks passed.
| MI355X preset | c1 TPOT p50 | c4 TPOT p50 | AL (c1 / c4) | KV cache per replica |
|---|---:|---:|---:|---:|
| FP8 TP4 (a8w4) | 3.75 ms | 6.26 ms | 2.91 / 3.03 | 2.18M tokens |
| FP8 specialized decode (a4w4) | 3.56 ms | 6.14 ms | 2.85 / 2.99 | 2.09M tokens |
| Quark TP4 | 3.85 ms | 6.05 ms | 2.88 / 3.03 | 2.19M tokens |
| Quark specialized decode | 3.60 ms | 6.03 ms | 2.86 / 3.03 | 2.09M tokens |

- Specialized decode vs TP4 + DSpark: 1.05x (FP8) and 1.07x (Quark) at c1, about 1.0x at c4. One DSpark verify step at 8k input (c1) takes 12.4 ms vs 13.6 ms (FP8) and 12.4 ms vs 13.0 ms (Quark).
- `--max-num-seqs`: every setting started and served with `AITER_CUSTOM_AR_MAX_SIZE` applied on all ranks, and none hit the "cannot be IPC-exported" abort. The custom all-reduce pool was allocated with expandable segments off. 64 and 128 gave the same TPOT (c1 3.64 vs 3.60 ms).
- `--monokernel` selects the same specialized decode as `--additional-config '{"decode_backend":"latency_specialized"}'` (identical log lines). The Quark model card's command passed.

### PR Pundit review

(Testing PR Pundit Code Review agent. Not all comments may be relevant. This is a one-time automated pass: please address what is useful, no need to request a re-review. A quick reply per point (useful or not, and why) helps us calibrate the agent. Reach out to @peymanr for suggestions and feedback.)

| # | | Finding | Where |
|---|---|---|---|
| 1 | 🟠 | MI355X specialized presets inherit `--max-num-seqs 128` while MI350X cap and its rationale are deleted | `recipes/models/mistralai/Mistral-Large-4-1T-A52B.yaml:639` |
| 2 | 🟠 | New MI350X MXFP4 presets show no measured TPOT or validation note, unlike every other AMD preset | `recipes/models/mistralai/Mistral-Large-4-1T-A52B.yaml:601` |

#### 1. 🟠 Should fix: MI355X specialized presets inherit `--max-num-seqs 128` while MI350X cap and its rationale are deleted
`recipes/models/mistralai/Mistral-Large-4-1T-A52B.yaml:639`

The MI350X specialized presets keep `--max-num-seqs 64` while the new `mi355x_tp4_specialized` and `mi355x_mxfp4_tp4_specialized` inherit `--max-num-seqs 128` from `base_args`. This PR also deletes the runbook paragraph and AMD troubleshooting entry explaining the cap (CUDA graph capture abort with `AITER_CUSTOM_AR_MAX_SIZE`), copying the specialized blocks four times by hand. This departs from the guard added in #64527. Either state why the cap is no longer needed and drop it everywhere, or keep the explanation and apply it to the MI355X presets; a YAML anchor (as in `GLM-5.3-Flash.yaml` `&gfx950_aiter`) would keep shared parts in one place.

**Who is affected:** Readers and users of the AMD MI350X/MI355X specialized-decode presets of the Mistral Large 4 recipe.

_Checked against the code by an independent pass._

#### 2. 🟠 Should fix: New MI350X MXFP4 presets show no measured TPOT or validation note, unlike every other AMD preset
`recipes/models/mistralai/Mistral-Large-4-1T-A52B.yaml:601`

The new `mi350x_mxfp4_tp4` and `mi350x_mxfp4_tp4_specialized` presets are the only AMD presets without a `runbook` of measured numbers. `mi350x_mxfp4_tp4`'s description also omits the 'Validated with DSpark and the FP8 KV cache' sentence that `mi350x_tp4` and `mi355x_mxfp4_tp4` carry, although it still selects DSpark. Add the MI350X measurements, or the validation sentence, for consistency with the sibling presets.

**Who is affected:** Readers comparing MI350X MXFP4 presets on the recipes site, who see no performance numbers or validation statement for them.

_Checked against the code by an independent pass._
